component.name: zapret2applet
component.summary: Graphical interface for managing zapret2 on Linux

description.p: zapret2applet is an independent Qt-based graphical interface for managing an already installed zapret2 service on Linux. It provides service control, configuration and profile management, network diagnostics, and update support.
The application does not include zapret2. The upstream component must be installed separately or installed using the application's supported workflow.
